Lists and Statistics
8
You can make lists in Desmos using square brackets like this: [1,1,2,3,5,8]
You can create lists with evenly spaced elements. [1,...,10] is a list of the integers between 1 and 10.
[1,3,...,11] is a list of the odd integers between 1 and 11.
You can use lists anywhere in expressions that you
would use a number.
Statistics functions like mean, median, min, max, and stdev take
a list as an argument and return a number.
Table columns are available as lists in the rest of the system.
